attr.title: TEOCIDA
attr.desc: TEOCIDA is an esoteric experience focused on puzzles, cloning mechanics, platforming challenges and experimental elements. Explore the enigmatic passageways of a twisted microcosm filled with symbolic faith landscapes and erotic nightmares.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch.io and copy all games files into assets folder.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569470/TEOCIDA/) or [Itch.io](https://vikintor.itch.io/teocida) and copy all games files into `assets` folder.
